digest.component_or_area: review-bot container IAM and Bedrock integration
propositions: The review-bot container requires Bedrock credentials via the existing rebar-gerrit-instance-role, which currently grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt permissions.

A scoped inline IAM policy must grant bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream (not bedrock:Converse) to Claude foundation models and cross-region inference profiles, delivered in a new infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf without modifying iam.tf.

IMDS reachability from the review-bot container must be verified (AC1 criterion); if IMDS token PUT succeeds, IAM-only grant suffices; if it fails, http_put_response_hop_limit must be set to 2 with exception recorded in ADR 0046.

The grant must be verified by real Converse API call from the instance role (not operator identity with bedrock:*), plus a negative control call to a non-Claude model returning AccessDeniedException, plus role-scoped IAM simulation.
Verification recipe and decision tree must be recorded in infra/runbooks/ so future operators can re-verify the grant without rediscovering that wildcarded identities cannot validate scoped policies.
